title: Hardware sizing
description: A 7-8B GGUF at Q4 needs ~6GB RAM/VRAM plus embeddings overhead; bigger models need proportionally more. Size the model to the machine, not the hype. Local Q&A works on modest hardware.

title: Multi-user considerations
description: Single-user by default; multi-user needs the API behind auth and per-user document scoping. Privacy per user requires access control at the retrieval layer. Plan scoping before sharing.

title: What it does not do
description: PrivateGPT does not train on your documents, does not phone home, and does not replace a search engine for exact lookup — it is Q&A over embeddings. Honest scoping prevents misuse. Use search for exact finds.
